Data is stored only in this browser (landlord list, default engineer details, and the current draft). Use "Manage Landlords" to add, edit, export or back up landlord records. To finish a certificate: click Print / Save as PDF, then choose "Save as PDF" as the destination in the print dialog and save it into the correct EP / Private folder.

This record is saved against the job on the office system, not in this browser — it is here whichever device you sign in on. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is left on this device when you close the tab. The customer's details are shown on this screen while you work, as they have to be. Submit for review sends the finished record to the office; it does not issue the certificate and emails nobody.
